title: Manchester United defeats Sabah 4-0 in Champions League group stage
seoTitle: Man Utd beats Sabah 4-0 in Champions League group stage
subtitle: Goals from Cunha, Fernandes, Sesko, and Martínez secure English victory in Minsk
excerpt: Manchester United thrashed Sabah 4-0 in their UEFA Champions League group stage opener, with goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, and Sebastien Šeško.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Manchester United arrived at Dinamo Stadium in Minsk for their first UEFA Champions League group stage match and defeated Sabah 4-0. The victory places the English club in third position in the standings, with three points.

Match Summary and Goals

The first goal came in the 28th minute, with Matheus Cunha finishing the offensive play. In the 43rd minute, Bruno Fernandes extended the lead, followed by a goal from Sebastien Šeško in the 45th minute, setting the halftime score at 3-0. In the second half, Alejandro Martínez scored in the 69th minute, sealing the 4-0 victory.

Manchester United Starting Lineup

Coach Michael Carrick fielded: Lammens (goalkeeper), Mazraoui, Yoro, Martínez, and Dorgu in defense; Tielemans and Mainoo as defensive midfielders; Mbeumo, Bruno Fernandes (captain), Matheus Cunha, and Šeško in attack.

Sabah Starting Lineup

Sabah started with Pokatilov in goal, Zedadka, Dasdamirov, McCarthy, and Puchacz in defense; Rakhmonaliev and Lepinjica in midfield; and Parris, Mickels, and Nwachukwu as forwards.

Performance and Statistics

The momentum chart showed Manchester United with 59.5% goal threat, while Sabah had 40.5%. The xG (expected goals) reflected the English side's offensive superiority, as they created more clear opportunities throughout the match.

Substitutions and Cards

United made substitutions in the 46th minute (Mount for Tielemans), 62nd minute (Dorgu received a yellow card), and 64th minute (Andrey Santos for Mainoo and Zirkzee for Šeško). Sabah registered a yellow card for Lepinjica in the 67th minute.

Table Position After the Round

With the victory, Manchester United accumulates three points and occupies third position in the group table, while Sabah remains without points in 35th place.

With information from BBC, The Guardian.
